title: A Provision for the Monsoon
author: Mirabel Quintana
blurb: Casper Nakamura, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
